body: Founder: 'portals should work without a hotkey' / 'jump in them and you go thru.' Both server's authoritative check and client's local-mode prediction required use_pressed ANDed onto scene_portal_triggered's own proximity check. Fixed on both sides: portal entry no longer needs a keypress; vehicle enter/exit (shares the same button) stays keypress-gated, split into its own branch. Existing anti-retrigger guards (portal_cooldown_until_ms server-side, transition_timer client-side) unchanged, verified still correct by reading through their logic. Both binaries build clean. Real server+bot regression smoke test (emily-bot, 3 bots, 8s, real ticket auth): PASS -- confirms no regression to connection/combat/respawn. Honest gap: portal walk-through itself verified via code tracing of the unchanged proximity math, not a live bot walkthrough (building portal-position-aware bot movement was judged disproportionate scope for this fix, flagged not silently skipped). Commit d48e57c.
title: S169-08: portals trigger on proximity, no hotkey needed
